chunks: Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd Allah ibn Zurarah, from 'Isa ibn 'Abd Allah al-Hashimi, from his father, from his grandfather, from 'Ali عليه السلام, who said:
“The mu'adhdhin is entrusted, and the Imam is responsible.”

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the prayer leader in congregational salat
key_terms.الْمُؤَذِّنُ: the one who gives the adhan, announcing the time of prayer
key_terms.ضَامِنٌ: one who bears responsibility or accountability
key_terms.مُؤْتَمَنٌ: one who is trusted with a duty and relied upon

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by saying the mu'adhdhin is entrusted and the Imam is responsible?
ai.summary: This hadith assigns distinct roles of trust and responsibility within congregational worship. The mu'adhdhin is entrusted with announcing the prayer correctly, while the Imam bears responsibility for leading the people in salat.
